title: SME Grants, Free Zones & Intellectual Property
description: The sequential roadmap for scaling enterprises—securing GEA government business development grants, Ghana Free Zones export tax holidays, Ghana Tourism Authority licences, and Copyright Office registrations.

consultant.name: Babanawo Consults
consultant.specialty: Ghana Trade Incentives & Intellectual Property Advisory

steps.title: Apply for GEA Enterprise Development Grants & Funding
steps.why: The Ghana Enterprises Agency (GEA) provides competitive matching grants, technical capacity building, and soft loans for eligible micro, small, and medium Ghanaian enterprises.
steps.do_this_when: When scaling business operations, upgrading machinery, or seeking grant funding.

options.label: GEA Business Support & Grants Eligibility Portal
options.notes: Official portal for enterprise support grants and eligibility criteria.

steps.title: Apply for Ghana Free Zones Export Licence
steps.why: Enterprises exporting at least 70% of production qualify under Act 504 for a 10-year corporate tax holiday, zero customs duty on imported machinery, and 100% foreign ownership guarantees.
steps.do_this_when: When establishing export-oriented manufacturing, processing, or service entities.

options.label: Ghana Free Zones Authority Licence Application
options.notes: Application portal for free zone enterprise status and investment incentives.

steps.title: Ghana Tourism Authority (GTA) Enterprise Registration
steps.why: Hotels, guesthouses, restaurants, tour operators, and travel agencies are legally required under the Tourism Act (Act 817) to be inspected and certified by GTA.
steps.do_this_when: Prior to opening hospitality or tourism facilities to guests.

options.label: GTA Tourism Enterprise Licensing & Services
options.notes: Classification requirements and licensing forms for accommodation and travel entities.

steps.title: Register Creative Works at the Copyright Office (ORCO)
steps.why: Authors, musicians, software developers, and artists register original intellectual creations to establish statutory proof of authorship and protect moral/economic rights.
steps.do_this_when: Upon creating proprietary software, books, music, or audiovisual works.

options.label: Copyright Office Registration Portal
options.notes: Official procedures and fee structures for registering copyright works in Ghana.

steps.title: National Information Technology Agency (NITA) Registration
steps.why: IT service providers, datacenter operators, and cloud software firms contracting with the public sector or processing state data must register with NITA under Act 771.
steps.do_this_when: When delivering corporate digital platforms or IT services in Ghana.

options.label: NITA Regulatory Services Portal
options.notes: Guidelines for IT standards and digital services compliance.
